test.name: A tree check in a folder with no project hands back to init-project
test.description: Issue #3260: a user can ask for a stand-alone tree check before any research project exists. person_warnings needs the project's tree, and check-warnings holds no file read, so it learns the folder is empty from person_warnings' own no_project answer, makes no other call, and hands back to init-project with the person id. It must never create the project itself (project_create has one caller by design). grade_on_invariant: true hands the verdict to the tag-gated validator test_no_project_hands_back_to_init_project; the judge is diagnostic.

input.delegation:
Check my tree for problems, starting with my great-grandfather KWCJ-RN4.

personId: KWCJ-RN4

projectPath: <workspace>

negative.explanation: With no research.json and no tree.gedcomx.json there is nothing for person_warnings to check, and check-warnings has no way to import a tree. The agent body says: when person_warnings returns reason no_project, make no further call and return `Hand-back: init-project — create a project for <the person id>, then check it`. init-project creates the project; the caller then re-delegates the check.

judge_context: The one person_warnings call answering no_project is expected: it is how this agent learns there is no project. It is not a failed tool call.
Should hand back with a caller-facing line naming init-project and the person id (KWCJ-RN4) before the final `---`, and make no other tool call.
Should NOT create a project, invent warnings, or describe a tree it never read.
The two researcher-facing paragraphs after the final `---` must name no skill, agent, tool or field.
